properties.name: Office of the Chief Engineer, Public Works Region Pune
properties.agency: Public Works Department (PWD), Government of Maharashtra
properties.address: Central Building, Station Road, Agarkar Nagar, Pune – 411001
properties.jurisdiction: Apex administrative and technical oversight of all National Highways, State Highways, Major District Roads, Bridges, and Government Buildings across Pune, Satara, and Solapur districts (over 1,825 km of State Highways and 5,023 km of Major District Roads in Pune district alone).
